{"command": "cat > plot.py <<'PY'
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, sharey=True, figsize=(9, 4))
x = np.arange(0, 11)
axes[0].plot(x, x**2); axes[0].set_title("Quadratic"); axes[0].set_xlabel("x")
axes[1].plot(x, 2.0**x); axes[1].set_title("Exponential"); axes[1].set_xlabel("x")
axes[0].set_ylabel("y")
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("figure.png", dpi=100)

python plot.py"}
